review.imagery: Root visually inspected all 45 native brochure candidates and nine observed website images. Thirty-five project concept renders are selected from original brochure resources. Generic lifestyle photographs, unassociated city context, masks and duplicate crops were excluded. Formative imagery retains concept scope. No as-built status is inferred.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all fifteen complete physical spreads 28–31, 40–41, 44–46, 49–50, 53, 56, 58 and 61. All twenty visible area headers were independently read at readable resolution. Whole original Tower 1 brochure and physical-page links are retained. Paired types are kept on their original spreads. Observatory total repeats across two levels and remains one whole-home figure. Printed metric component differences are explicit.
review.location: Root inspected complete original map spread 27 and current official-page journey estimates. Financial Centre Road and Sheikh Zayed Road labels establish regional context. No exact entrance coordinate or kilometre journey was inferred.
review.provenance: Official 65-spread brochure, current official HTML and observed website resources were downloaded by ordinary public GET on 7 November 2026 with URLs, bytes and SHA256 receipts. Original extracted media, drawing notices and protected identity are preserved. No enquiries or access-challenge bypass.

unavailable: Exact visitor entrance coordinates, live routing, Tower 2 drawings and a separately verified roof-level area remain unavailable within the reviewed source scope. Minor printed metric component differences remain unresolved.
